subject: Part 2c: fix search-context daemon event-loop wedge
description: Reproduced 2× during benchmarking: ~3 back-to-back POST /subconscious/search-context calls wedge the daemon event loop — GET /health stops responding and later requests hang past their socket timeout (a 300s urllib timeout never fired). Onboard is fine; the wedge is cumulative in the search-context/agentic path. Investigate routes/subconscious.js (the search-context handler) and lib/subconscious/index.js (runAgenticContextSearches per-round embed + any sync/blocking op). Hypotheses: a synchronous/blocking op on the main event loop per round, an unreleased handle/listener leak accumulating across calls, or embed-sidecar backpressure. Fix the block/leak; add a regression test firing N rapid search-context calls and asserting /health stays responsive. Independent of the other tasks but shares the search-context path with Part 2b, so coordinate. Files: routes/subconscious.js, lib/subconscious/index.js.

summary: Fixed the /subconscious/search-context daemon event-loop wedge. ROOT CAUSE: a rerank-sidecar cold-start spawn storm, not slowness. The multi-round agentic search-context loop calls the cross-encoder rerank() once per round (rerank is ON by default in lib/search/memory-search.js). rerank's sidecar is spawned lazily on first call; the old spawnSidecar() guard deduped only on the PID file, which the child writes seconds late (after Node boot + listen + ~80MB model load). So every rerank() failure during that cold window spawned ANOTHER sidecar — a few back-to-back search-context calls (each several rounds) detonated one cold start into N concurrent model-loading processes that saturated the CPU and starved the daemon event loop (/health stops, calls hang past socket timeout). Onboard was fine because it uses the eagerly-spawned embed sidecar, not lazy rerank. FIX (root cause, no timeout band-aid): (1) in-process spawn cooldown latch (_lastSpawnAt/SPAWN_COOLDOWN_MS=30s) in lib/rerank.js + lib/embed.js caps spawns to one per cooldown regardless of PID-file timing; (2) server.on('error') EADDRINUSE guard in lib/rerank-server.js + lib/embed-server.js so a bind-race loser exits before loading a model; rerank-server no longer unconditionally unlinks a live winner socket. REGRESSION TEST test/subconscious-search-context-wedge.test.js: part1 — a 24-call rerank() burst during simulated cold start spawns AT MOST ONCE (negative control: reverting the fix yields 24 spawns and fails); part2 — 6 rapid sequential search-context calls each return while a concurrent 25ms event-loop probe stays responsive (maxLag ~56ms). RESULTS: new test 10/10 pass; related suites green (context-compiler-search, rerank-route, suggest-rerank, real embed.test.js 13/13, real rerank.test.js 5/5 — real sidecars spawn exactly once). Note: the actual fix lives in lib/rerank*.js + lib/embed*.js (where the bug is), not routes/subconscious.js or lib/subconscious/index.js, which were correct. Robust to repeated c
